newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Graboplast group '97 Q1 profit HUF475.5mln.
newsitem.headline: Graboplast group '97 Q1 profit HUF475.5mln.

text.p: Hungarian home improvement product maker Graboplast RT posted a HAS consolidated after-tax profit of 475.5 million forints in the first quarter of 1997 as against an after-tax profit of 215.5 million forints in the same period of 1996.
The group reported net sales revenues of 4.019 billion forints for January-March 1997, up from 3.142 billion in the same three months of 1996, Graboplast said in a statement.
Graboplast's operating profit surged to 445.4 million forints in the first quarter from 346.5 million in the same period of 1996 while pre-tax profit surged to 581.9 million from 257.9 million.
